name: MolmoAct2 Official YAM Absolute-Source Alignment
description: Use the absolute official MolmoAct2 source copy to correct the MolmoSpaces MolmoAct2-YAM task/scene/camera route and produce a fresh rollout video. Do not invent custom room/countertop/viewpoint placement.

userStories.title: Audit absolute official MolmoAct2 source
userStories.description: As a reproduction maintainer, I want direct evidence from the absolute official MolmoAct2 source copy so that task and placement decisions are source-grounded.
acceptanceCriteria: Also inspect nearby official MolmoAct2 sim_eval files if these two import placement/camera/task constants from them.

Inspect current route files: molmo_spaces/data_generation/config/molmoact2_official_yam_box_config.py, molmo_spaces/configs/camera_configs.py, molmo_spaces/policy/learned_policy/molmoact2_yam_policy.py, scripts/datagen/run_pipeline.py, and examples/molmoact2_official_yam_box/.

Write artifacts/molmospaces/molmoact2_yam_integration/official_absolute_alignment_audit_20260623.md with source-backed official task/object/camera/placement facts, current mismatches, and exact evidence paths.
Do not modify behavior files in this story except the audit artifact and Ralph progress files.
userStories.notes: The official source is outside the molmospaces checkout; do not declare it missing before checking the absolute paths above.

userStories.title: Correct route to official-seen task semantics
userStories.description: As a reproduction maintainer, I want the executable route to avoid unseen custom scene/task semantics and use the closest representable MolmoAct2 official YAM setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Patch only minimal files needed for MolmoAct2OfficialYamBoxDataGenConfig and its scene/camera support.

The default official run must not use examples/molmoact2_yam_room_tabletop or countertop/frontfix variants unless the report clearly labels them non-official diagnostics; for this run prefer examples/molmoact2_official_yam_box or a source-grounded official-like asset scene.
Preserve official instruction 'put everything into the box'.
Preserve official objects obj_073-a_lego_duplo, obj_056_tennis_ball, and open_box unless the official source proves a different naming/asset mapping is required.
Preserve official camera names top_cam, left_cam, right_cam, official-like resolution/HFOV/orientation semantics, and do not invent a new viewpoint just to make a better-looking video.
If exact ManiSkill/SAPIEN placement cannot be represented in MolmoSpaces/MuJoCo, document the approximation and blocker explicitly; do not hide it.
Run py_compile on every changed Python file.
userStories.notes: This is a correction toward what MolmoAct2 has seen, not a room-beautification task.

userStories.title: Generate fresh official-aligned rollout video
userStories.description: As Kunyu, I want a fresh video from the corrected route to visually inspect whether task and scene are now right and whether behavior improves.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify or reuse MolmoAct2 /act server at http://127.0.0.1:8202/act; if unavailable, report the blocker with evidence instead of silently switching policy.

Run scripts/datagen/run_pipeline.py with --config MolmoAct2OfficialYamBoxDataGenConfig --robot bimanual_yam --policy molmoact2_yam and a bounded horizon of 300-400 steps if runtime/storage allow; otherwise justify the shorter horizon.
Save H5, top_cam/left_cam/right_cam MP4s, and a combined/three-camera MP4 or contact sheet under artifacts/molmospaces/molmoact2_yam_integration/ with a unique 20260623 official-aligned run name.
Analyze and report approach/contact/grasp/lift/place flags plus success/reward metrics using scripts/analyze_molmoact2_official_yam_box_rollout.py or an equivalent source-readable analyzer.
Write artifacts/molmospaces/molmoact2_yam_integration/final_official_absolute_alignment_report_20260623.md with changed files, command, video paths, evidence matrix, and next blocker/gate.
Do not call the result successful unless official success metric or clear task-directed behavior supports it.
userStories.notes: Deliverable is video plus honest source-aligned evidence, not a success claim.
